compiled_state.title: plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf: plugins/dso/data/** listed twice (lines 28 and 47)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Bug Report

**Priority**: 4 (backlog)
**Zero Inference Rule**: Directly observed in diff for PR #337 by FP-recovery opus review.

## Observed behavior
The file .claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf contains the pattern 'plugins/dso/data/**' twice: once at line 28 and once at line 47. check-plugin-boundary.sh tolerates duplicates but the duplication adds noise to the allowlist and makes future audits less clear.

## Expected behavior
Each path appears exactly once in the allowlist.

## Reproduction
grep -n 'plugins/dso/data' .claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf

## Fix
Remove the duplicate entry at line 47.
